article_evidence: 物価上昇に抗議するデモ
candidate_evidence: ブラッド・ピットさん（52）との離婚を申し立てた
findings: Entirely different subject: the candidate reports a Hollywood divorce filing, while the article is about anti-government protests in Iranian cities.

Peripheral errors only: the origin city is given as タブリーズ instead of マシュハド and arrests as 72 instead of 52, but the central event (price-protest turning into the largest anti-government demonstrations since 2009, spreading to at least seven cities) is supported.
Central win (Best Picture and Director, four awards) is supported; the "最多13部門で候補" nomination count is an unsupported added detail.

findings: Reverses the article’s central outcome: the city concluded a settlement and Starbucks committed to mandatory anti-bias training, yet the candidate says the settlement was refused and the training rejected.

article_evidence: 「エールフランスが存続できるかは五分五分だ」と述べた
candidate_evidence: 「経営危機は解消された」として存続に強い自信を示した
findings: Reverses the minister’s central statement: he put Air France’s survival at fifty-fifty, whereas the candidate has him declaring the crisis resolved and expressing strong confidence.

Central claim (the economy minister warning the strike-hit airline may not survive) is supported; the 5.1% union demand is an unsupported detail, and the text breaks off mid-sentence (a string-gate matter, not grounding).
Central claims supported, including the chairman’s resignation after the pay talks collapsed; the 5.1% union demand and the 10日 date are unsupported details.
